Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for MNNIT Allahabad Ad hoc Faculty Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the MNNIT Allahabad Ad-hoc Faculty position?
faq.answer: The application process is through a walk-in interview. The walk-in interview is scheduled for 07 September 2026. Candidates should attend the interview on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Ad-hoc Faculty role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's Degree in a relevant discipline with First Class (Minimum 60% Marks or 6.5 CPI). A PhD is preferred, especially in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in Medical Devices.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Ad-hoc Faculty position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of ₹70,900/- per month.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Ad-hoc Faculty post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Ad-hoc Faculty in the Department of Biotechnology position.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the walk-in interview with the required documents.

faq.question: Q6. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at MNNIT Allahabad, Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh, 211004.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type is Contract, for a maximum of 11 months.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any age limit mentioned for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify a minimum or maximum age limit. Candidates are advised to check the detailed notification for any specific age criteria.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry original documents and self-attested photocopies of ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is 05/2026.
